purpose: Pinned offline model manifest for the experience-distillation LLM-turn bench. The operator installs the model OUTSIDE the repository and records the remaining digests with the bench --digest command. No weights are stored in the repository; the bench refuses to run with numbers that were not produced by the pinned model.
revision_note: default branch HEAD at pin time (verified via the Hugging Face file tree API)
onnx_commit_note: last-change commit shown by the Hugging Face tree page for onnx/ at pin time
license: apache-2.0 per upstream Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (onnx packaging by onnx-community); confirm the model page license text during install

digest_sources.onnx/model_q4.onnx: sha256 of the file content, taken from the Hugging Face LFS pointer (lfs.oid) of the pinned revision; re-verified locally after install (match)
digest_sources.small_files: sha256 recorded from the locally installed files with bench --digest during the offline install on 2026-11-10 (operator install, files are not stored in the repository)

install_record.note: the model lives in a local directory outside the repository; the bench verifies every manifest digest before generation on each run

operator_workflow: 1. Download offline, outside the repository, preserving repo-relative paths: huggingface-cli download onnx-community/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --revision 22942cb7d7ba4cc81bb4673549ca4d4614469b5e --include "*.json" "*.txt" "onnx/model_q4.onnx" --local-dir <dir>

2. Record digests: node scripts/bench-experience-llm-distill.mjs --digest <dir> — all sha256 values below were recorded this way during the offline install on 2026-11-10; keys stay exactly as listed (the command emits the same key shape).
4. Repeat run: same command plus docs/research/experience-llm-distill-2026-11-10.json as the last argument — the bench compares behavior fields bit-for-bit and prints REPRODUCED true/false.
bench_without_model: no numbers: missing arguments exit 2 (MODELS REQUIRED), manifest without recorded/verified digests or without the installed files exits 3 (LLM_MANIFEST_EMPTY / LLM_MANIFEST_NOT_INSTALLED / LLM_MANIFEST_MISMATCH:<file>) — a hash that differs from a recorded one stops the run before generation.

worker_guarantees.fetch: overridden to reject with LLM_NETWORK_DISABLED before any text is processed
worker_guarantees.decoding: greedy (do_sample:false), max_new_tokens 700, cpu, two passes per case for the deterministic_pair check
